title: Layer-sensitivity fusion + drift-aware canary runbook for E4M3/E5M2 FP8 enablement
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Safely enable E4M3/E5M2 FP8 quantization profiles on Hopper for a subset of production traffic using a drift-aware canary and a layer-sensitivity fusion check. This ticket defines the runbook, automation hooks, telemetry gates, and fallback policy for progressive activation.
background: Previous FP8 efforts focused on bulk calibration and coarse activation heuristics. We've observed edge-case regressions tied to specific layer sensitivity patterns and transient distribution drift during peak workloads. Rather than an all-or-nothing selector, we need a runbook that fuses per-layer sensitivity signals with stability signals (latency, KV-cache hit patterns, prefix distribution) and uses a drift detector to dynamically throttle activation and trigger graceful fallbacks.
success_criteria: 1) FP8 E4M3/E5M2 profiles active for canary traffic with no more than 2% regression on delta-perplexity-95 and no customer-facing errors for 72h. 2) Automatic rollback triggers within 60s for severe degradation and within 5m for medium degradations. 3) Telemetry coverage for per-layer bias, sample-level token-level divergence, and end-to-end tail latency. 4) Runbook validated in simulated production traffic and one customer pilot.
scope: Includes: build fusion service that aggregates per-layer sensitivity map + runtime stability metrics; implement drift-aware canary scheduler; create automation for progressive ramp and automated rollback; extend telemetry dashboards and alerts; end-to-end test harness and golden-trace comparison. Excludes: post-enablement quota billing changes and enterprise billing contracts.
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (shadow): run FP8 profiles in shadow for 48h on 5% sample traffic with golden-trace capture. Phase 1 (canary): enable on 0.5% live traffic with drift detector active and 5-minute conservative hysteresis. Phase 2 (ramp): 0.5% -> 2% -> 5% over 48h if gates pass. Phase 3 (customer pilot): pick 1 low-risk customer on Dedicated with opt-in. Each phase has acceptance checks and automated rollback policies.
telemetry_and_alerts: Telemetry to emit: per-shard layer-sensitivity heatmap, delta-perplexity-95, token-level KL divergence, median and 99.9 latency, KV cache hit ratio, prefix length distribution, sample error rate. Alerts: P0 if delta-perplexity-95 > 3% over 15min window OR error_rate spike > 0.5% OR 99.9 latency regression > 2x baseline. P1 if steady small drift persists > 3hrs. All alerts must create a pager incident and annotate canary bucket id.
automation_and_fallbacks: Automated actions: 1) Immediate soft-fallback reducing FP8 activation fraction by 50% if medium alarm; 2) Full rollback to INT8/FP16 variant if severe alarm; 3) Escalation webhook to oncall and runbook runbook-run webhook for diagnostics collection (prefix KV dump, golden-trace sample). Hysteresis: per-shard multiplier and time-based cooling (min 5m, max 1h) to avoid flapping.
testing_plan: Unit tests for fusion logic, integration tests for scheduler, synthetic workload sweep including adversarial seeds (long tail prompts, highly repetitive prefix, numerically sensitive tokens). Golden-trace regression suite: 2000 seed prompts across domains (qa, summarization, code) and statistical pass criteria (delta-perplexity-95 < 2% and no sample-level semantic divergence flagged by human sniffing). Load test with KV-cache hot/cold transitions to validate latency SLO under FP8.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: transient drift during peak can cause false positives and rollbacks. Mitigation: use multi-window drift detector (1m, 5m, 30m) and require corroborating metrics before full rollback. Risk: per-layer false sensitivity due to calibration noise. Mitigation: smooth sensitivity map with EMA and require cross-batch consistency. Risk: config explosion across shards. Mitigation: limit per-shard knobs and prefer global multipliers with shard-level overrides.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Shadow pass with no critical semantic regressions and telemetry stable. 2) Canary 0.5% passes all P0/P1 gates for 24h. 3) Automation correctly triggers fallback in simulated failure and logs diagnostics to S3. 4) Runbook reviewed and signed off by ML infra, runtime, telemetry, and SRE.
notes: 2025-02-11: Kickoff meeting with runtime, telemetry, and ML infra. Agreed on delta-perplexity-95 as primary quality metric. 2025-02-13: Prototype fusion service returns coherent per-layer maps; initial false positives observed on long-code prompts. 2025-02-15: Implemented multi-window drift detector and hysteresis multiplier. 2025-02-18: Canary automation lambda added; telemetry dashboard stubbed. Next: run full shadow sweep and collect golden-trace diffs.
